    55→local function clamp01(x)

   153→local function buildEditableTexture(size, pixelFn)
   154→	local ei = keep(AssetService:CreateEditableImage({Size = Vector2.new(size, size)}))
   155→	local buf = buffer.create(size * size * 4)
   156→	local o = 0
   157→	for py = 0, size - 1 do
   158→		local v = (py + 0.5) / size
   159→		for px = 0, size - 1 do
   160→			local u = (px + 0.5) / size
   161→			local r, g, b, a = pixelFn(u, v)
   162→			buffer.writeu8(buf, o,     math.clamp(math.floor(r * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255))
   163→			buffer.writeu8(buf, o + 1, math.clamp(math.floor(g * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255))
   164→			buffer.writeu8(buf, o + 2, math.clamp(math.floor(b * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255))
   165→			buffer.writeu8(buf, o + 3, math.clamp(math.floor(a * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255))
   166→			o += 4
   167→		end
   168→	end
   169→	ei:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(size, size), buf)
   170→	return {content = Content.fromObject(ei), ref = ei}
   171→end

   284→-- 6 Polar Radial Ellipsoidal Cloud Domes x 5 rings x 24 circular segments = 1,296 curved triangles!
   285→-- True 360° circular polar geometry (ZERO 90° square corners!) + fast OIT alpha-sort for locked 60+ FPS!
   286→local function buildMultiCloudCluster(seed)
   287→	local em = keep(AssetService:CreateEditableMesh())
   288→	local subSpecs = {
   289→		{off = Vector3.new(-0.36,  0.22, -0.28), rx = 0.74, ry = 0.62, rz = 0.30, rot = 0.4, tiltX = -0.13, tiltY =  0.13},

   291→		{off = Vector3.new(-0.14, -0.38, -0.06), rx = 0.74, ry = 0.60, rz = 0.29, rot = 2.9, tiltX =  0.14, tiltY =  0.10},
   292→		{off = Vector3.new( 0.22,  0.34,  0.06), rx = 0.68, ry = 0.60, rz = 0.27, rot = 4.1, tiltX = -0.12, tiltY = -0.11},
   293→		{off = Vector3.new(-0.28, -0.06,  0.18), rx = 0.66, ry = 0.56, rz = 0.26, rot = 5.2, tiltX =  0.09, tiltY =  0.13},
   294→		{off = Vector3.new( 0.14, -0.26,  0.28), rx = 0.68, ry = 0.58, rz = 0.26, rot = 1.1, tiltX = -0.10, tiltY =  0.09},
   295→	}
   296→	local rings, segs = 5, 24
   297→	for wIdx, sp in ipairs(subSpecs) do
   298→		local cf = CFrame.new(sp.off) * CFrame.Angles(sp.tiltX, sp.tiltY, sp.rot)
   299→		local cCrinkle = fbm3(seed + wIdx, -seed, wIdx * 1.7) * 0.10
   300→		local cBase = cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 0, sp.rz + cCrinkle))
   301→		local cNorm = (cf:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))).Unit
   302→		local cVid = em:AddVertex(cBase)
   303→		local cNid = em:AddNormal(cNorm)
   304→		local cUvid = em:AddUV(Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5))
   305→
   306→		local vids, nids, uvids = {}, {}, {}
   307→		for ir = 1, rings do
   308→			local rFrac = ir / rings
   309→			vids[ir] = {}; nids[ir] = {}; uvids[ir] = {}
   310→			local rimAtten = 1 - 0.70 * (rFrac * rFrac)
   311→			local domeH = math.sqrt(math.max(0, 1 - rFrac * rFrac * 0.86)) * sp.rz
   312→			for is = 0, segs do
   313→				local th = (is / segs) * math.pi * 2
   314→				local vx = rFrac * math.cos(th)
   315→				local vy = rFrac * math.sin(th)
   316→				local crinkle = fbm3(vx * 1.85 + seed + wIdx, vy * 1.85 - seed, wIdx * 1.7) * 0.11 * rimAtten
   317→				local baseP = cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
   318→					vx * sp.rx * (1 + crinkle * 0.20),
   319→					vy * sp.ry * (1 - crinkle * 0.16),
   320→					domeH + crinkle
   321→				))
   322→				local wn = (cf:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(vx * 0.24, vy * 0.24, 0.94))).Unit
   323→				vids[ir][is] = em:AddVertex(baseP)
   324→				nids[ir][is] = em:AddNormal(wn)
   325→				uvids[ir][is] = em:AddUV(Vector2.new(0.5 + vx * 0.475, 0.5 + vy * 0.475))
   326→			end
   327→		end
   328→		for is = 0, segs - 1 do
   329→			local f = em:AddTriangle(cVid, vids[1][is], vids[1][is + 1])
   330→			em:SetFaceNormals(f, {cNid, nids[1][is], nids[1][is + 1]})
   331→			em:SetFaceUVs(f, {cUvid, uvids[1][is], uvids[1][is + 1]})
   332→		end
   333→		for ir = 1, rings - 1 do
   334→			for is = 0, segs - 1 do
   335→				local f1 = em:AddTriangle(vids[ir][is], vids[ir + 1][is], vids[ir + 1][is + 1])
   336→				em:SetFaceNormals(f1, {nids[ir][is], nids[ir + 1][is], nids[ir + 1][is + 1]})
   337→				em:SetFaceUVs(f1, {uvids[ir][is], uvids[ir + 1][is], uvids[ir + 1][is + 1]})
   338→				local f2 = em:AddTriangle(vids[ir][is], vids[ir + 1][is + 1], vids[ir][is + 1])
   339→				em:SetFaceNormals(f2, {nids[ir][is], nids[ir + 1][is + 1], nids[ir][is + 1]})
   340→				em:SetFaceUVs(f2, {uvids[ir][is], uvids[ir + 1][is + 1], uvids[ir][is + 1]})
   341→			end
   342→		end
   343→	end
   344→	return {em = em, content = toStaticMeshContent(em), tris = #subSpecs * (2 * rings - 1) * segs}
   345→end

   409→local function buildAxisymmetricConeMesh(seed)

   413→	for r = 0, rings do

   415→		vids[r] = {}; nids[r] = {}; uvids[r] = {}
   416→		local baseR = 0.16 + 0.34 * (t ^ 0.92)

   423→			local rad = math.max(0.06, baseR + flute + rip)

   426→			nids[r][s] = em:AddNormal(Vector3.new(c * 0.88, sn * 0.88, 0.47).Unit)
